SCTIMST Project Research Scientist III Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) post is scheduled for 06 October 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 78000 plus 20% HRA per month. This is a consolidated salary for the contract period.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Clinical Research/ Health Sciences/ Public Health/ Pharmacy/ Pharmaceutical Science/ Biotechnology with 5 years of experience, or a PhD with 2 years of experience, or a Pharm D with 2 years of experience in clinical research/trials.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST, Women) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 45 years. However, age relaxation is provided for certain candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, up to 5 years of age relaxation is provided for candidates who have experience working in Government Research Organizations.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) position at SCTIMST.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, 695011.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with passport-size photographs.
